title: Getting hate for using AI in my game
author: Electrical_Top5563
selftext:
This is a little showcase of a Revolutionary War game I’ve been making on Roblox after work.

My game got review bombed at soft launch over the AI use. I posted a longer video showing more of what I’d built, got a ton of shit for it, and ended up taking it down. One person literally used the in-game feedback to tell me it was AI-generated and that I should never make a game again lol.

And yeah, I used AI. Of course I did. I work 9-5 and art + 3d modeling is way outside my skill set. I also spent a stupid amount of my free time figuring out how the musket combat should feel, building the maps, and getting all the different systems to work together. It sucks to spend that much time on something and watch people write the whole thing off in two words.

If you play it and think the combat sucks, tell me the combat sucks. I can work with that. I’m mostly just frustrated that so much of the conversation stopped at “you used AI.”
